{{Quote|Crates?!!? I hate 'em. Worst thing that ever happened to the universe. And did you know that there are people mass producing them? I could not believe it.|[[Riyan Kiner]] to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]|<ref name="SWG:TMHP1" />}}
The '''Joben Crate Company''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] manufacturing company near [[Coronet/Legends|Coronet]] that produced crates. It was owned by [[Talan Joben]].<ref name="SWG:TMHP1" />

==History==
{{Quote|I just said...someone has attacked my company and destroyed my precious crates. That's what happened.|[[Talan Joben]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMHP1" />}}
[[File:Joben_Crate_Company.jpg|thumb|250px|The crate manufacturing site after the attack]]
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Joben Crate Company manufactured crates that were sold throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SWG:TMHP1" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the company was attacked and many of their crate manufacturing machines as well as most crates were destroyed. A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] investigated this attack for ''[[Corellia Times]]'' reporter [[Vani Korr]] to find out if this was the work of the machine-hating [[Meatlumps]]. The spacer found a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] among the destroyed machines with a message saying that bombs had been planted in Joben-brand crates and placed near [[Hotel/Legends|hotels]] on several [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. The adventurer located all the bombs just in time and also found evidence that led to the culprit of these terrorist attempts: the insane retired adventurer [[Riyan Kiner]], who had targeted the company because of his boundless hate of crates.<ref name="SWG:TMHP1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Joben Crate Company appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TMHP1" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Joben Crate Company was added to the game with the update dubbed "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
